notes.title: Handpass VR Update - 28/11
notes.notes:
We've updated HandpassVR with a few features to help remove the worry of hitting controllers together along with making the ball easier to catch. 


Patch Notes:


    Added a guide showing where the ball can be picked up on the controller.
    Made the ball easier to catch
    Improved shadow realism and optimization

notes.title: Update - Global Leader-boards & Bug fixes
notes.notes:
We've been fixing bugs and adding in features (First of many) and today we're happy to release global leader-boards shown at the end of each game. We have also fixed the occasional bug with the ball not firing from behind the target and the hand not tracking. 

Patch notes: 

- Added Global Leader-boards 
- Fixed a glitch where the ball didn't launch properly 
- Fixed tutorial text not aligning correctly 
- Fixed hand occasionally not tracking properly 


Happy Handpassing!
